correctness.rationale: PASS for every irrational phi/pi in (0,1), epsilon in [0,1], all finite orders and nonnegative finite waiting times. The exact matrix-product density from Peralta is e^-T[1-epsilon+epsilon S_k]. Interior partial sums W_m=Re A(1-z^m)>=alpha=Re A-|A|, whereas the terminal W_k=Re A-Re(Bz^k)>=beta>alpha. Summation by parts with nonincreasing a_j=e^-T_j gives S_k>=alpha a_1+(beta-alpha)a_k>alpha for finite times (alpha<0). Irrational rotation makes W_m dense arbitrarily close to alpha; a final long finite wait realizes inf S_k=alpha, with strict interior negative witnesses above threshold. Thus epsilon_star=1/(1-alpha) and critical finite-density positivity. Normalization and non-Markovian consequence correctly rely on original full primary theorem, not claimed new. Independent direct matrix products for k=1..7 reproduced the oscillatory density.
